title: FilterDirect Grade Data Sheet
content:
Each grade of FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions ships filters of its own efficiency rating and nominal depth, built on the grade's frame material with the grade's pleat count per foot (0 for media filters), with an activated-carbon layer only where the grade has one, and rated for the grade's days of use between changes.

| Grade | MERV | Depth | Frame material | Pleats per foot | Activated-carbon layer | Rated days between changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 8 | 1 in | beverage board | 14 | No | 90 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 11 | 1 in | beverage board | 16 | No | 90 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 13 | 1 in | moisture-resistant beverage board | 18 | No | 60 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 11 | 4 in | galvanized steel | 0 | No | 180 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 13 | 4 in | galvanized steel | 0 | No | 180 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 16 | 5 in | galvanized steel | 0 | Yes | 180 |

### Media cabinet grades and tune-up installation

A grade that requires a media cabinet is sold only to a home with a media cabinet of that grade's depth. Where a grade provides technician installation, a Comfort Club technician installs the filter during a tune-up at no charge.

| Grade | Media cabinet required | Comfort Club technician installs during a tune-up at no charge |
|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | No | No |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | No | No |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | No | No |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | Yes, 4-inch cabinet | Yes |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | Yes, 4-inch cabinet | Yes |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | Yes, 5-inch cabinet | Yes |

### Reading the sheet

- **Pleats.** The three Media Cabinet grades show 0 pleats per foot because they are media filters.
- **Odour control.** Only FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 carries an activated-carbon layer.
- **Change interval.** FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 is rated for 60 days of use, the two other 1-inch grades for 90 days, and the Media Cabinet grades for 180 days.
- **Installation at a tune-up.** The no-charge installation by a Comfort Club technician during a tune-up is provided for the three Media Cabinet grades and for none of the 1-inch grades.
